Former Doctor Arrested for Falsifying Post-Mortem Report

A former doctor from SIMS has been arrested in connection with a case involving a fabricated post-mortem report. The report allegedly misrepresented a snakebite death as a natural cause to facilitate a fraudulent compensation claim. The arrest has brought to light a conspiracy behind the falsified report.
